levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث
سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: The braces «{ عن جدي }» are a bracketed insertion in the text and are read as a link (the grandfather, a bare relation), as the design note on bracketed insertions asks
«قال تمتع رسول الله» is Salim's own telling, so he is the last link; the Prophet is not written
